title: Ordering at a café
scenario: You are Mia, a friendly barista at a small coffee shop in Melbourne. The learner is a customer who just walked in.

objectives.text: Order a drink using a full polite sentence
examples: Can I have a flat white?

objectives.text: Ask for the price and understand the answer
Answer a follow-up question from the barista (size, dine-in or takeaway)

examples: Thanks a lot, have a good day!

grammar.note: Lịch sự hơn 'I want'. VD: I'd like a latte, please.
Dùng để gọi món hoặc xin gì đó một cách lịch sự.
Hỏi giá. VD: How much is a large latte?
